prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions overall tended to overestimate positive impact (especially in rounds 1, 2, and 5), but underestimated gains in winning tests during rounds 3, 4, and 6.
home wait_info changes can be helpful, backed by 3 winning tests (rounds 3, 4, and 7), though 2 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1 and 5).
sign_in hint changes can be helpful, backed by 2 winning tests (rounds 4 and 6), though 4 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1, 2, 5, and 7).
choose_path layout changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (rounds 1 and 5).
home notification changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (rounds 2 and 6).
Evidence remains thin for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, and finish new_screen because their test outcomes disagree, as well as for all kinds of change with only a single test.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Tray Launch Prep Screen: Add a new dedicated screen before completing onboarding explaining how to invoke, hide, and manage the pet from the system desktop tray. (why: Finish step takes median 395s (mean 5815s) and 7 support tickets reported pets missing on desktop or confusion around hiding/controlling pets.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Animated Story Intro Redesign: Redesign the story intro screen with full bleed video previews showing real desktop pet interactions across different operating workflows. (why: The choose_path stage has a high mean time of 514s, showing initial user hesitation or lack of context regarding desktop pet mechanics.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Data Preservation Notice: Display an explicit data protection hint on sign-in clarifying that pet progress and custom creations are securely saved to the account. (why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) reported pets missing or resetting after re-signing into their account.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Step Timer & Animation: Add an animated visual render progress indicator with a real-time step countdown timer to the waiting screen. (why: The home waiting stage takes a long median of 201s (mean 2336s), and wait_info changes are supported by 3 winning historical tests.)
4: [home, notification] Render Completion Audio Notification Toggle: Add an audio completion alert switch and chime test button on the waiting screen so users know when generation finishes while backgrounded. (why: High average waiting time (2336s) leads users to background the app or think it stalled, causing dropoffs or app non-opening tickets.)

scores.note: Adding a new screen to finish step has negative historical performance (-4.7%) and high development cost.
Video preview redesign requires release effort with weak evidence from only 1 past test (+0.3%).
Config-only hint addressing top support complaint (8 emails) with 2 past winning sign_in hint tests (+1.8% avg).
Home wait_info has the strongest pattern with 3 historical winning tests (+1.8% avg) targeting long wait times.
Home notification changes consistently showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (+0.6% avg).
